_comment: Ad settings. The ids below are Google's official AdMob TEST ids: safe to use, they never pay. Replace them with your AdMob app's real ids before publishing (docs/ADS.md). Ads only run in the Android/iOS app; the web build has none.
_simulate_on_desktop: Desktop debug runs show stand-in test ads so every ad placement can be played and tested without a phone.
_interstitial: A full-screen ad after every Nth finished level, cleared or lost, but never within interstitial_min_gap_seconds of another ad.
